- Move API key and DB credentials to .env file
- Add .env.example template for new users
- Add comprehensive .gitignore to protect sensitive files

## Bug Fixes
- Fix critical bug in Last 5 stats: add sort by date before .head\(5\)
- Add proper data validation to prevent None values
- Fix division by zero in fair odds calculation
- Remove unnecessary semicolons in Python code

## Error Handling
- Replace generic Exception catches with specific exception types
- Add timeout \(10-15s\) to all HTTP requests
- Add requests.exceptions.Timeout handling
- Add requests.exceptions.RequestException handling
- Improve JSON response validation with .get\(\) methods

## Logging
- Replace all print\(\) statements with proper logging
- Add file logging \(football_data.log\) + console output
- Add exc_info=True for detailed error stack traces
- Use appropriate log levels \(INFO, WARNING, ERROR\)

## Code Quality
- Replace magic numbers with named constants \(MATCHES_PER_ROUND, SCAN_DAYS, etc.\)
- Add inline comments explaining formulas
- Fix requirements.txt encoding issue
- Add python-dotenv dependency

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Bash(PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 "$PYTHON" -c "
import psycopg2
conn = psycopg2.connect\(host=''localhost'', port=5433, dbname=''football_data'', user=''admin'', password=''secret_password''\)
cur = conn.cursor\(\)

cur.execute\(''SELECT AVG\(lambda_home\), AVG\(lambda_away\), AVG\(lambda_home + lambda_away\) FROM poisson_odds''\)
r = cur.fetchone\(\)
print\(f''avg lambda_home: {round\(float\(r[0]\),3\)}''\)
print\(f''avg lambda_away: {round\(float\(r[1]\),3\)}''\)
print\(f''avg suma lambd:  {round\(float\(r[2]\),3\)}''\)

# Sprawdzmy co bukmacher mowi o golach
cur.execute\(''''''
SELECT 
  AVG\(1.0/odd_home + 1.0/odd_away\) as implied_goals_proxy,
  AVG\(odd_over_25\), AVG\(odd_under_25\),
  AVG\(1.0/odd_over_25\) as p_over
FROM upcoming_odds 
WHERE odd_over_25 > 0 AND odd_under_25 > 0
''''''\)
r = cur.fetchone\(\)
print\(f''\\nBukmacher avg p\(over2.5\): {round\(float\(r[3]\)*100,1\)}%''\)
print\(f''Bukmacher avg kurs over2.5: {round\(float\(r[1]\),3\)}''\)
print\(f''Bukmacher avg kurs under2.5: {round\(float\(r[2]\),3\)}''\)

# Poisson p\(over2.5\) vs bukmacher
cur.execute\(''''''
SELECT 
  AVG\(1.0/p.poisson_over25\) as poisson_p_over,
  AVG\(1.0/u.odd_over_25\) as bm_p_over,
  AVG\(1.0/p.poisson_under25\) as poisson_p_under,
  AVG\(1.0/u.odd_under_25\) as bm_p_under
FROM poisson_odds p 
JOIN upcoming_odds u ON p.fixture_id = u.fixture_id
WHERE u.odd_over_25 > 0 AND u.odd_under_25 > 0
''''''\)
r = cur.fetchone\(\)
print\(f''\\nP\(over2.5\):  Poisson={round\(float\(r[0]\)*100,1\)}%  BM={round\(float\(r[1]\)*100,1\)}%''\)
print\(f''P\(under2.5\): Poisson={round\(float\(r[2]\)*100,1\)}%  BM={round\(float\(r[3]\)*100,1\)}%''\)

# Histogram lambd
cur.execute\(''''''
SELECT 
  SUM\(CASE WHEN lambda_home + lambda_away < 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as below_15,
  SUM\(CASE WHEN lambda_home + lambda_away >= 1.5 AND lambda_home + lambda_away < 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as r_15_20,
  SUM\(CASE WHEN lambda_home + lambda_away >= 2.0 AND lambda_home + lambda_away < 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as r_20_25,
  SUM\(CASE WHEN lambda_home + lambda_away >= 2.5 AND lambda_home + lambda_away < 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as r_25_30,
  SUM\(CASE WHEN lambda_home + lambda_away >= 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as above_30,
  COUNT\(*\)
FROM poisson_odds
''''''\)
r = cur.fetchone\(\)
print\(f''\\nHistogram sumy lambd:''\)
print\(f''  < 1.5: {r[0]}''\)
print\(f''  1.5-2.0: {r[1]}''\)
print\(f''  2.0-2.5: {r[2]}''\)
print\(f''  2.5-3.0: {r[3]}''\)
print\(f''  > 3.0: {r[4]}''\)
print\(f''  Total: {r[5]}''\)

# Reczny test: wezmmy 2 przecietne druzyny z tej samej ligi
cur.execute\(''''''
SELECT ts.team_name, ts.avg_xg_for, ts.avg_xg_against, ts.med_xg_for, ts.med_xg_against,
       ts.luck_factor, ts.total_points_l5, t.league_id
FROM team_stats_last_5 ts
JOIN teams t ON ts.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE t.league_id = 39
ORDER BY ts.avg_xg_for DESC
LIMIT 20
''''''\)
print\(f''\\nPremier League druzyny \(xG\):''\)
for r in cur.fetchall\(\):
    print\(f''  {r[0]:20s} xg_for={r[1]:5.2f} xg_ag={r[2]:5.2f} med_for={r[3]:5.2f} med_ag={r[4]:5.2f} luck={r[5]:6.2f} pts={r[6]}''\)

conn.close\(\)
")
